title: Classification of finite-dimensional Nichols algebras of rank two in twisted Yetter--Drinfeld categories
summary: Let \(G\) be a finite non-abelian group, let \(Φ\in Z^3(G,\mathbb C^\times)\) be normalized, and let \(V,W\) be finite-dimensional simple objects of \({}_G^G\mathcal{YD}^Φ\). We classify, up to interchange, the braided-indecomposable pairs \((V,W)\) whose supports generate \(G\) and for which \(\mathcal B(V\oplus W)\) is finite-dimensional. The classification consists of eight cases with five possible support quandles.
